## Summary
- Add deterministic `agent-self-merge.yml` and resolver logic gated by `AGENT_ALLOW_SELF_MERGE=false` by default.
- Require trusted current-head Sepo self-approval, no requested changes, passing or pending checks, and mergeability before merge or auto-merge.
- Mark draft PRs ready, merge into the PR’s configured base, and bind merge commands with `--match-head-commit`.
- Wire orchestrator handoff/authorization, marker-upserted self-merge status comments, docs, and focused regression tests.

## Verification
- `npm run build`
- `node --test dist/__tests__/self-merge.test.js dist/__tests__/resolve-self-merge-cli.test.js dist/__tests__/handoff.test.js dist/__tests__/orchestrate-handoff-cli.test.js dist/__tests__/orchestrator-preflight-cli.test.js dist/__tests__/post-response-cli.test.js dist/__tests__/sub-orchestration.test.js dist/__tests__/envelope.test.js`
- `git diff --check`

Closes #229

## AI Review Synthesis

<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis -->

> Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**.
> Requested by @lolipopshock.

## Summary of PR/Issue
- PR #235 implements issue #229 under parent issue #170.
- It adds an opt-in deterministic `agent-self-merge` route after current-head Sepo self-approval.
- The intended behavior is to mark draft PRs ready when needed, then merge or enable auto-merge into the PR’s configured base after approval, check, mergeability, and requested-change guards pass.
- This is the simplified main-branch replacement for earlier self-merge work in PR #202.

## Review
The implementation is broadly aligned with the requested simplified design, and the rubrics review passes. One scoped correctness issue remains in the pending-check path for already-enabled auto-merge.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Existing auto-merge bypasses mergeability guard | WARNING | With pending checks, `autoMergeRequestExists` returns `auto_merge_enabled` before checking current mergeability eligibility, so an ineligible PR can be marked done. |
| Resolver output failure can skip visible status | INFO | A rare uncaught failure while writing outputs/body files would prevent the workflow status comment from being posted. |

## Progress
- Existing PR discussion had no inline review comments or review threads before synthesis.
- Posted one inline comment on [`.agent/src/self-merge.ts` line 268](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/235#discussion_r3231663296).
- No replies were added, no comments were minimized, and no threads were resolved.
- Prior PR #202 concerns around `--match-head-commit`, draft readiness, and configured-base merging are addressed in this PR.

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>Existing auto-merge bypasses mergeability guard</summary>

**Cause:** [`resolveSelfMerge`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/e34114b760817c85d32dac7449a0117382b45b55/.agent/src/self-merge.ts#L267-L275) treats any existing auto-merge request as success while checks are pending. That skips the `canEnableAutoMerge(...)` eligibility check used for a fresh auto-merge enable.

**Candidate solutions:** Run the existing-auto-merge path through the same eligibility check, or block when current merge state is ineligible. Add regression coverage for `autoMergeRequestExists: true`, pending checks, and an ineligible state such as `DIRTY`, `BEHIND`, or `CONFLICTING`.

**Comments:** Codex flagged this as the main unresolved issue; Claude and rubrics otherwise judged the design shippable.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Resolver output failure can skip visible status</summary>

**Cause:** The workflow posts status only when the resolver step succeeds and produces `status_post` plus `body_file`. If body-file creation or output writing throws unexpectedly, no PR status comment is posted.

**Candidate solutions:** Add an earlier prepared fallback body/status path, or accept this as a low-probability infrastructure edge.

**Comments:** This is optional hardening, not required for the fix-pr pass.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step
`FIX_PR`: the auto-merge guard issue is a small deterministic code/test change suitable for automation.

## Final Verdict
`MINOR_ISSUES`

## Action Items
- [ ] Apply the same mergeability eligibility guard to the existing-auto-merge pending-check path and add regression coverage for an ineligible merge state.

## Notes

- The linked PR #202 comment asked for the simpler model: current-head self-approval, checks/mergeability, no requested changes, configured-base merge, draft PRs marked ready, and `--match-head-commit`. PR #235 matches that direction.

- No rubric-specific follow-up needed.
